platforms.name: CJSR FM 88 Edmonton Digital Album/EP Submission Email and Physical Route
platforms.country: Canada / Edmonton, Alberta / campus-community radio; the official digital route accepts albums and EPs and the page gives instructions for submissions sent from outside Canada
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee, account, login or mandatory payment is stated. A separate CAD 200 advertising package is offered only to local artists and is not required for editorial consideration.
platforms.manualReviewReason: CJSR authorizes music@cjsr.com for digital albums and EPs but does not accept single tracks. The station requires actual downloadable files through stable cloud links or Bandcamp download codes, rejects Spotify, Tidal and other paid-streaming-only links, and advises against expiring services such as WeTransfer. A human must confirm that the selected release is an album or EP, verify ownership, track metadata, focus tracks, origin, track lengths, language warnings, download access and pitch copy, and confirm that the music is not wholly AI-generated under CJSR's January 2026 AI policy before sending manually.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-14 from CJSR's official Submit Music, homepage and AI Policy pages. The station also publishes a physical-delivery route and special customs wording for packages sent from outside Canada. Its homepage displayed a current chart and Hot Wax update dated 2026-07-07, and the site footer is dated 2026. The optional CAD 200 local advertising package is separate from music submission and was not treated as a fee or editorial shortcut. The email was validated only through official publication, syntax, first-party domain alignment and explicit purpose binding; no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.

platforms.name: CJSF 90.1 FM National Music Director Submission Form and Music Coordinator Email
platforms.country: Canada / Burnaby-Vancouver, British Columbia / campus-community radio; the digital national-distribution route is not limited to local artists, while non-local physical submissions are explicitly rejected
platforms.feeAmount: No mandatory submission payment is stated for the official CJSF National Music Director release form or the published Music Coordinator email. The page separately promotes the optional !earshot Distro service as an alternative.
platforms.manualReviewReason: CJSF's official Music Department page directs releases to a National Music Director form that grants broadcast rights to CJSF and the participating campus-community network and distributes releases through !earshot Distro to more than 70 stations. Singles may enter !earshot Distro but are not considered for CJSF's local library; non-local physical submissions are rejected. The external form's live fields, privacy wording, discoverability/self-disclosure labels and any runtime login, CAPTCHA or validation controls were not passively enumerated. A human must review the rights grant, select accurate optional identity labels, confirm release type, local status, ownership, metadata and assets, inspect runtime controls and submit manually. The published cjsfmusc@sfu.ca Music Coordinator address remains a purpose-bound adjacent music contact and must not be used to bypass the current form.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-14 from CJSF's official Music Department, Submissions, Contact and homepage pages. The Music page states that submissions are shared through the National Music Director partnership and !earshot Distro with staff and programmers at non-profit stations across Canada, while remaining non-public. It lists cjsfmusc@sfu.ca for the Music Coordinator; an older official Submissions page also directs music by email to that address. The homepage showed Summer 2026 hiring and featured programs aired from 2026-07-07 through 2026-07-10. The institutional email was validated through official publication, syntax, staff-role purpose and the station's official SFU relationship only; no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
